Mainly coating and drying equipment that imparts various functional properties to base materials such as film, metal foil and paper, it designs, manufactures, installs and sells various dryers, heat treatment machines, chemical processing machines and other industrial machinery. All products are made to order, with each product being one-of-a-kind. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,737 million.
